notes.text:
G – Am – G/B – C7: bass walks G-A-B-C, line-first. C7 spelled
with its seventh (Bb) — and the melody puts that Bb in the tune.

C7 promises F... then bar 5 just goes home to G. Evaded
resolution — the Bb un-flattens back to B. First fake-out.
Same C7, second exit: this time it resolves — but sideways.

The seventh-side resolution (Josh's coinage): C7 lands on Bb,
the key of its own seventh. The destination note was already
ringing inside the dominant. Bare Bb octaves — no third, mode
unproven at the moment of landing (sore-hands accident, kept).

Bb: I – V – IV. Melody phrase-endings crown Bb as home; zero
E naturals in the whole section (F major never had a chance —
F starved for its leading tone).

D major = V of G, the intentional turnaround home. F#5 leading
tone in the melody; Eb5→D5 half-step squeeze against it. Two
voices closing on G from opposite sides.

Melody arc: C–D–C–Eb–D–C climb, peak F#5, resolve to held D.
The most melody-like phrase in the piece (bars 1–3 are riff).
